## Summary

I implemented TikZ-diagram rendering via the Tectonic engine in the LaTeX backend, matching the merged upstream design.

### New file: `docling/backend/latex/engines/tectonic.py`
`TectonicEngine(RenderEngine)`:
- **Module-scope `shutil` and `subprocess`** imports so tests can patch them independently.
- **`__init__(timeout=60.0, allow_shell_escape=True)`** — locates the binary with `shutil.which`; on success sets `_is_available=True` and `binary_path=Path(...)`, otherwise `_is_available=False` and logs the WARNING containing *"Install Tectonic and make it available on PATH"*.
- **`is_available()`** returns `self._is_available`.
- **`render(tikz_code, preamble="", source_root=None)`** — sanitizes the preamble, stages local dependencies (path-traversal protected, skipping files outside `source_root`), runs `subprocess.run(..., timeout=self.timeout)` with `-Z shell-escape` only when `allow_shell_escape=True` (never adds a `search-path=` argument), returns `None` on `TimeoutExpired`/`CalledProcessError`, and otherwise converts the PDF to a cropped `ImageRef`.
- **`_sanitize_preamble_for_tectonic`** — replaces pdfTeX assignment lines with `% docling: removed for Tectonic compatibility: <original_line>`, leaving reference/test lines untouched.

### `docling/datamodel/backend_options.py`
Added `tikz_engine` (`Literal["tectonic"]`), `tikz_engine_timeout`, and `tikz_engine_allow_shell_escape` to `LatexBackendOptions`.

### `docling/backend/latex/backend.py`
`LatexDocumentBackend` now extracts the document preamble, sets up a thread-pool executor for TikZ rendering, and awaits/shuts it down during parsing.

### `docling/backend/latex/handlers/environments.py`
`_process_tikzpicture` uses `TectonicEngine` when `tikz_engine='tectonic'`, calling `render()` with `source_root` set to the parent directory when file-backed. On `None`/exception it degrades gracefully: `picture.image=None`, `picture.meta.code.text` set to the TikZ markup (including `\begin{tikzpicture}`), and `picture.meta.code.language.name='TIKZ'`.

- Fallback path (engine unavailable), success path (mocked), command construction (`-Z shell-escape` on/off, no `search-path=`, timeout forwarded), and both error paths returning `None` all confirmed.
